name: apothecary_stomper_enters_and_puts_two_counters_on_a_creature_you_control
notes: Printed: 'When this creature enters, choose one - Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. / You gain 4 life.' Seat 0 casts the Stomper ({4}{G}{G}); when it enters the trigger's mode 0 is chosen and the target is seat 0's Bear: exactly two +1/+1 counters on it (4/4), none on the Stomper or on seat 1's Bear, and no life is gained.
